rewrite.source: Tns process runner j/st, repo check Rcr, abort check Ue and environment N
rewrite.reason: the recovered runner and repository services are host inputs this runtime does not carry
rewrite.replacement: readGitDiffHunks uses execFile with the source shortstat and patch argument lists, the source 5s timeout, a 4 MiB output bound and the shared Git isolation; the shortstat >500-file bail-out and --cached unstaged-path removal keep the source semantics

notes: Header paths resolve to the new side and decode C-quoted UTF-8; plain a/x b/x headers use the shared path.
Metadata before the first hunk is ignored; hunk lines keep their space, plus or minus marker and empty lines are retained.
The file cap counts parsed and oversized files together; the hunk cap is 400 lines.
readGitDiffHunks bails out to an empty result when shortstat reports more than 500 files, and drops staged paths that still have unstaged changes.
The diff dialog and its navigation remain out.
